currentUserGoal: Keep pushing the redesign until the core loop feels testable, with the next slice making failure a real game-over/meta-progression state.
changesMade: Made the dormant phase behave more like a hard run-ended state in the prototype update loop: after HP reaches zero, Scourge timers, wound pressure warning state, accumulated damage, and Tiny Sprinkler elapsed time stop advancing.
Added dedicated dormancy report visual regions on the Phaser meta screen: run-over copy, a permanent GT reward line, summary stats, and an explicit Begin Next Run action hint.
Changed the meta screen title/copy toward a direct Game Over presentation while preserving the new-canon Dormancy language.
Refreshed the dormancy report immediately after memory purchases so banked GT and owned memory text update on the meta screen.
Added a direct guard so root touches invoked through DOM or code do nothing once the run is dormant.
Added runEnded, dormancyRewardLine, dormancyReportLines, and dormancyActionHint to the browser debug payload.
Added a real DOM dormancy report output at data-testid="redesign-dormancy-report" so browser agents can read game-over/reward/report text without canvas inspection.

Fixed a transition-state publish issue: after HP collapse, the scene now republishes debug/DOM state after refreshReadout hides active run tools, so Dew Pulse and Root Salve are no longer visible to DOM agents on the meta screen.
Updated CORE_MECHANICS_REDESIGN.md and CORE_MECHANICS_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md to document the hard run-ended state and DOM dormancy report.

knownIssues: The meta screen is functionally clearer but still first-pass visually; it is not yet a rich, polished separate scene with bespoke art transitions.
The report can show +0 Permanent GT if the player lets fast dormancy collapse without healing; this is expected for the smoke route but should be tuned for real first-run pacing.
The DOM dormancy report is intentionally visually transparent like the readable state unless focused/inspected; it exists primarily for agents and accessibility.
The old default route and obsolete stress route still exist; use ?redesign for this rework.
nextRecommendedSteps: Playtest the new game-over/meta screen manually and judge whether the report/reward/tree layout feels like enough of a separate game state.
Add stronger visual transition polish for dormancy, such as a brief collapse-to-memory animation before the report settles.
Consider adding Scourge Sense or Last Stand next, depending on whether the next slice should improve threat readability or add a meaningful second-chance mechanic.
Eventually split the meta screen into its own scene/state if the prototype UI keeps growing.
doNotRevert: Do not re-enable random screen clicks to restart a run; Begin Next Run is the explicit restart action.
Do not make active run tools visible or usable in the DOM layer once runEnded is true.
Do not remove data-testid="redesign-dormancy-report"; it is part of the agent-accessibility contract.
Do not treat the old canvas-only route or ?stress route as the redesign target.
